excerpt: server : handle CTRL_BREAK_EVENT on Windows for clean shutdown (#32080) Windows can't send SIGINT to a child process, so scripts that launch llama-server could only kill it, which skips the clean shutdown. The console control handler only handled CTRL_C_EVENT, so a CTRL_BREAK_EVENT sent to the server's own process group ended it with STATUS_CONTROL_C_EXIT. server: handle CTRL_BREAK_EVENT the same as CTRL_C_EVENT in the console control handler scripts/moe-cache-tune.py: on Windows, start the server in a new process group and stop it with CTRL_BREAK_EVENT. On other platforms, stop it with SIGINT. In both cases, kill it afterwards as a fallback. tests: add test_server_ctrl_break (Windows only) and a ServerProcess.share_console option. Console control events only reach a server that shares the test's console, hence the option.
